title: Qualify production identity and controlled account invitation
scope: Qualify the distinct production Auth0/Resend context through the accepted deployed runtime: exact issuer/client/callback/MFA/session/logout/current-grant behavior and one explicitly authorized controlled invitation/account message. Bind production mail domain/recipient, build/driver/protocol and current initial-Admin verification evidence before read shadow.
tests: Actual production hosted login/callback/session/logout binds issuer/subject and current membership; wrong nonce/issuer/recipient and revoked grant deny without disclosure.

One controlled invitation traverses the accepted Resend driver and recipient; delivery alone creates no membership, acceptance requires verified intended identity and valid single-use token; reused/expired/revoked token denied with no extra send.
Production issuer/client/callback/mail-domain/recipient and runtime hashes are distinct/current and reviewed; all source sync, customer contact and provider mutation egress remains disabled.
non_scope: No source synchronization, customer outreach, provider business effects, restore/cutover or configuration repair. A failed production setting is a held qualification requiring separately reviewed environment change. Only the exact approved controlled invitation/account test may send or change test membership.
